summary: Brixmor Operating Partnership LP, an indirect subsidiary of Brixmor Property Group Inc., filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing entry into a $400 million delayed-draw term loan agreement with Wells Fargo as administrative agent and a lender syndicate on November 5, 2026. The facility is undrawn, can be drawn within six months, matures February 15, 2031, carries a twelve-month extension option at a 0.125% fee, permits up to $200 million in incremental term loans, and prices at SOFR plus 0.70%-1.55% or base rate plus 0.0%-0.55%. This is a routine credit-facility arrangement, not a special situation; watch leverage and future drawdowns.
